title: Shared definitions for the plan portal JSON
description: Every file schema refers to these as #/$defs/<name>. They are not repeated in each file: tools/portal-sync-check.ps1 merges them into each file schema before validating (Test-Json cannot follow a reference to another file). Any other validator (the portal) must do the same.

id.description: An id that refs.json can explain (page id, task id, Q-NNN, commit, or an alias such as P1).

summary.description: One to three plain sentences for a smart non-specialist.

chain.description: Thought chain: cause → action → why it matters. Must contain at least one →.

status_label.description: Plain status words, e.g. 'Open', 'Done', 'Waiting for you'.

script_path.description: Repo-relative path of a PowerShell 7 script, forward slashes. The file must exist (the checker reports MISSING-SCRIPT otherwise); use null until the script is written.

wiki_path.description: Repo-relative path of the page this record was translated from (wiki/... or STATUS.md).

content_hash.description: SCHEMA §10.2 content_hash of that page at the moment of translation. A different current hash = STALE.

schema_ref.description: Optional pointer to this file's schema, for editors.

phase_status.description: Phase page status in plain words: planned, ready, in-progress, gate-review, done, blocked.

label.description: A category or tag name. It must be one of the names in plan/portal/taxonomy.json (the single list); tools/portal-sync-check.ps1 reports BAD-LABEL otherwise. The list is not repeated here.

tag_pair.description: Exactly two different tags from the 'tags' list in plan/portal/taxonomy.json (checked by tools/portal-sync-check.ps1, BAD-LABEL).
